title: 1 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 17
description: Ten questions on 1 Samuel 17: Goliath's challenge, David's visit to the camp and his victory with a sling and a stone.

questions.text: Where did Saul and the men of Israel encamp against the Philistines?
questions.explanation: Saul and the men of Israel encamped in the valley of Elah and set the battle in array against the Philistines.

questions.text: From which city did the Philistine champion Goliath come?
questions.explanation: The champion who came out of the Philistine camp was Goliath, of Gath.

questions.text: For how many days did the Philistine present himself morning and evening?
questions.explanation: The Philistine came near morning and evening and presented himself forty days.

questions.text: What did Jesse tell David to bring to the captain of his brothers' thousand?
questions.explanation: Jesse told David to bring ten cheeses to the captain of their thousand and to see how his brothers were doing.

questions.text: Who became angry with David for coming down to the battle?
questions.explanation: Eliab, David's oldest brother, heard him speaking to the men, and his anger burned against David.

answers.text: Abner, the captain of the army

questions.text: Which animals did David tell Saul he had struck while keeping his father's sheep?
questions.explanation: David told Saul that his servant had struck both the lion and the bear.

questions.text: Why did David take off the armor and sword Saul gave him?
questions.explanation: David told Saul he could not go with them, because he had not tested them, and he took them off.

answers.text: They were made for a king
They were far too heavy to lift
Eliab told him to remove them

questions.text: How many smooth stones did David choose out of the brook?
questions.explanation: David chose five smooth stones out of the brook and put them in his shepherd's bag.

questions.text: Where did David's stone strike the Philistine?
questions.explanation: David slung a stone and struck the Philistine in his forehead, and he fell on his face to the earth.

questions.text: To which city did David bring the head of the Philistine?
questions.explanation: David took the head of the Philistine and brought it to Jerusalem, but he put his armor in his tent.
